jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.location: London or remote within the UK
jobs.description_text:
About Griffin
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do
Our culture
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work 
and
 home life.
We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.
Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.
Learn more about our culture.
The team
We're building the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on, bringing best-in-class technology, user experience and banking together in the embedded finance space. You'll be the third hire on our Customer Success team, helping shape how we support and grow our customer base from the ground up.
The opportunity
As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a book of customers and become the person they rely on to get real value from our product. You'll work closely with our implementation and product teams, spot growth opportunities within your accounts, and help define what great customer success looks like at Griffin as we scale.
What success looks like
In your first 6-12 months, you'll have built strong, trusted relationships across your customer book, driven measurable improvements in retention and account growth, and become a go-to voice on what customers need from Griffin. You'll have also helped sharpen how the wider team approaches customer success as we grow.
To do this you'll own
Fully owning your customer book and being accountable for their delight, retention and commercial growth through proactive and responsive communication
Becoming a true product expert by developing a deep understanding of Griffin's products and systems, so you can support and advocate for your customers
Getting hands-on with your customers, understanding the detail of their challenges and going the extra mile to help resolve them
Working closely with our implementation teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience and faster time-to-value
Uncovering upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth
Improving existing processes and meaningfully harnessing AI to optimise the customer experience
We expect you to shape this role:
This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.
Your background
To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:
2-3 years' experience in B2B customer success or account management. Financial services or fintech experience is a bonus, not a requirement, provided

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
The Opportunity
Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.
Multiverse is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive growth across both sides of our marketplace: attracting industry-leading enterprise partners and shaping a best-in-class platform experience for our learners.
About the role:
Lead go-to-market strategy
 for new product, feature, and narrative launches, effectively guiding cross-functional teams toward common goals.
Craft sales narratives and enable teams
 by generating launch excitement and providing compelling assets. You will build segment-focused sales playbooks and establish feedback loops between sales and product to enhance offerings.
Create compelling, structured messaging
 and positioning statements that highlight product benefits and resonate with your audience. You will also organise internal communications to ensure company-wide alignment.
Establish success metrics
 and analyse product performance, reporting to key stakeholders and using data to refine messaging and GTM strategies.
Own competitive landscape analysis,
 becoming an expert on market trends to help shape the product roadmap.
Partner cross-functionally
 with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.
Champion the voice of the customer
 in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.
About you:
5+ years of relevant product marketing experience, including close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders.
Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.
Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.
Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.
Motivated by high-expectation stakeholders, with a proven ability to earn and retain trust through challenges.
High internal expectations for what is possible, coupled with the ability to bring others along on that journey.
Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.
Adept at building workflows from scratch: turning ambiguous, 0-to-1 briefs into clear plans with defined success metrics, and owning timelines end-to-end.
Benefits
Time off
